text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commercial banks lend residents 943.5 million dinars at end-December 1996 compared with 941.2 million dinars three months earlier.
- Bahrain backs a decision by Arab foreign ministers calling for a freeze of ties with Israel.
- Bahrain is to establish a new annual award for companies carrying out the best industrial projects in the country.
- Direct air links could soon be resumed between Bahrain and Russia.
- Trade volume between Bahrain and Russia remained small, amounting to $1.2 million in 1996.
- Bahrain's offshore banking units' assets stood at $66.9 billion at the end of the fourth quarter of 1996.
- Bahrain-Egyptian joint committee discusses ways of boosting cooperation in economic, trade and investment fields.
- Bahrain achieves 191.7 million dinar trade surplus in 1996 -- the highest in ten years.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak meets Bahrain's foreign minister. They discussed the latest developments in the Middle East peace process.
